intro: Brother Neals is a monk residing in Northshire Abbey within Elwynn Forest. Responsible for managing the abbey's stores of food and drink, he spends much of his time overseeing shipments and sampling the vintage produced by the local vineyard.

p: Tucked away in the upper belfry rooms of Northshire Abbey, Brother Neals looks after the monastery's culinary provisions and beverage stores. He takes a particular, enthusiastic interest in the Northshire vineyards, carefully tracking grape manifests and ensuring the quality of the abbey's renowned wine by tasting it with dedicated frequency. Despite the peaceful duties of inventory and cellar management, he keeps close tabs on the shipments arriving from the valley's surrounding fields.
